# AngleForMen

> AngleForMen (https://www.angleformen.com) is Uttarakhand's premier independent companion classified directory and verified advertising network, connecting discerning adult gentlemen with verified independent VIP companions, call girls, luxury models, and sensual wellness massage providers across major tourist and urban destinations in Uttarakhand.

## Core Platform Overview

AngleForMen operates strictly as an independent advertising portal and intermediary service under Section 79 of the Information Technology Act. The platform maintains a zero-tolerance policy against advance fee scams, fraud, non-consensual media, and fake listings. All listed companion profiles undergo photo and identity verification prior to listing approval.

The platform strictly enforces a mandatory **"Zero Online Advance Payment" (Cash on Delivery)** policy. Clients must never send digital payments, registration fees, hotel booking charges, or UPI transfers before meeting in person. All financial arrangements are settled strictly between consenting adults in person upon physical verification.

- **Platform URL:** https://www.angleformen.com/
- **Support Inquiries:** support@angleformen.com
- **Abuse & Scam Escalations:** abuse@angleformen.com
- **Age Restriction:** Strictly 18+ (Adults Only, Age Verification Enforced)
- **Primary Service Types:** Incall (Companion's Private Residence / Studio) & Outcall (Reputed 4/5-Star Hotels & Luxury Hill Resort Suites)
- **Payment Policy:** 100% Cash on Delivery (Zero Online Advances)
- **Primary Regional Focus:** Uttarakhand, India (Dehradun, Haldwani, Mussoorie, Nainital, Ramnagar / Jim Corbett, Rishikesh)

## Safety, Verification & Anti-Fraud Standards

1. **Zero Upfront Deposit Rule:** Neither AngleForMen nor genuine independent companions will ever request digital advances, registration charges, medical clearance deposits, or taxi charges. All payments are made strictly in person via cash on delivery (COD).
2. **Profile Verification:** Advertisers provide genuine photos and valid government identification proving age of majority (18+).
3. **Discreet Communication:** Direct communication via secure phone calls, WhatsApp, or Telegram. Clients are advised to maintain mutual respect, clear boundaries, and discretion.
4. **Hotel Outcall Best Practices:** When booking outcalls, book only verified 4-star, 5-star, or reputable boutique resorts. Avoid secluded or unverified meeting points.
5. **Mutual Consent & Protection:** Safe sex practices (condom usage) and mutual respect are strictly mandatory for all encounters.
